verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms SolidJS integrates with TypeScript and JSX (jsxImportSource config), but there is no evidence describing type-checking of expressions/props inside JSX templates themselves (e.g., typed component props enforced in JSX, template-level type errors caught by tsc or IDE). Missing for 10: documentation or examples of type errors being caught within JSX templates, typed prop validation in markup, or TSX-specific type-checking tooling.
